title: Happy giraffe
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='giraffeBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FFD54F'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#F9A825'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M38 62 L44 30 L54 30 L56 62 Z' fill='#FFCA28'/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='4' fill='#C6791A'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='48' r='4.5' fill='#C6791A'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='57' r='3.5' fill='#C6791A'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='74' rx='26' ry='16' fill='url(#giraffeBody)'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='68' r='4' fill='#C6791A'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='66' r='5' fill='#C6791A'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='74' r='4' fill='#C6791A'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='80' r='4.5' fill='#C6791A'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='82' r='3.5' fill='#C6791A'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='84' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#F9A825'/>
  <rect x='42' y='84' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#F9A825'/>
  <rect x='54' y='84' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#F9A825'/>
  <rect x='64' y='84' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#F9A825'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='94' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8D5524'/>
  <rect x='42' y='94' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8D5524'/>
  <rect x='54' y='94' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8D5524'/>
  <rect x='64' y='94' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8D5524'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M71 72 Q82 68 80 58' stroke='#F9A825' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='57' r='4' fill='#8D5524'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='24' rx='15' ry='11' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  <!-- ossicones -->
  <rect x='40' y='9' width='4' height='8' rx='2' fill='#F9A825'/>
  <rect x='50' y='9' width='4' height='8' rx='2' fill='#F9A825'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='8' r='3.5' fill='#8D5524'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='8' r='3.5' fill='#8D5524'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='18' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#F9A825' transform='rotate(-25 31 18)'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='18' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#F9A825' transform='rotate(25 63 18)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='28' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#FFE082'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='27' r='1.5' fill='#8D5524'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='27' r='1.5' fill='#8D5524'/>
  <!-- happy mouth -->
  <path d='M51 30 Q57 35 63 30' stroke='#8D5524' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='21' r='3.2' fill='#4A2C0A'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='21' r='3.2' fill='#4A2C0A'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='20' r='1.1' fill='#FFF176'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='20' r='1.1' fill='#FFF176'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='26' r='2.5' fill='#FF8A65' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='2.5' fill='#FF8A65' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
